constraints.product_desc: ligand bit x standardised descriptor for each of 3 descriptors, plus the metal block; no constraints

design.descriptor_standardisation: z-score over the five metals' tabulated values (no labels)
design.bootstrap: ligand-clustered, 2000 reps, delta R2 vs reference on pooled metal-out rows

verdict_rule: best non-additive arm on potency/metal_out must reach additive_desc + 0.05, with ligand-clustered bootstrap CI lower bound > 0, and the ligand-disjoint delta positive
caveats: One seed for the screen; only the best arm is confirmed on five seeds.
The held-out metal's descriptors are known at test time by construction; this is not a zero-shot element prediction.
Censored rows are dropped as in msrs_lomo_surface (potency 18.4%), so the surface is fitted on the potent side.

product_desc multiplies 2048 bits by 3 descriptors; a tree can represent the same interaction through free_desc given enough depth, so a null result on product_desc alone is not evidence against the interaction.
